name: IRC_REC_EVENT_LOC_USAGES
description: This table stores the event location related details.

columns.name: LOCATION_USAGE_ID
columns.description: Primary Key for this table. This is an auto-generated field.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to IRC_REC_EVENTS_B table

columns.name: EVENT_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Indicates if the event is in-person or virtual as a look up code, ORA_IRC_REC_EVT_FORMAT

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Location where event is occurring in case of office location. Foreign key to PER_LOCATIONS table.

columns.name: ADDRESS_ID
columns.description: Address of event location in case of in-person event. Foreign key to PER_ADDRESSES_F table

columns.name: LOCATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether office location or not. Uses look up type ORA_IRC_REC_EVT_LOC_TYPE.

columns.name: MAX_CAPACITY
columns.description: Max capacity of the event in a location

columns.name: WEB_CONF_LINK
columns.description: Web conference link for virtual event

columns.name: ACCESS_CODE
columns.description: This column stores the access code for virtual event

columns.name: PHONE_NUMBER
columns.description: Phone number in case of virtual event

columns.name: PHONE_AREA_CODE
columns.description: Phone area code in case of virtual event

columns.name: PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Phone country code in case of virtual event

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LOCATION_FQN_ID
columns.description: Denormalized location id used for event search indexation

columns.name: CITY_ID
columns.description: Denormalized hz_geographies city id used for event search indexation

columns.name: STATE_ID
columns.description: Denormalized hz_geographies state id used for event search indexation

columns.name: COUNTRY_ID
columns.description: Denormalized hz_geographies country id used for event search indexation

columns.name: LATITUDE
columns.description: Denormalized irc_geo_coordinates Latitude information used for event search indexation

columns.name: LONGITUDE
columns.description: Denormalized irc_geo_coordinates Longitude information used for event search indexation

columns.name: MEETING_ID
columns.description: Used to store meeting id of virtual events

columns.name: PHONE_LEGISLATION_CODE
